audit.whatIsWrong: phases[1] through phases[6].side all read "Skill" while content win[1..6] already say "Leona" and the matching why text on every one of those rows already describes Leona favoured (e.g. phases[1].why: "the chain is live and the lane's geometry answers to your blade"). Only phases[0] (Skill/Skill) is actually aligned.
audit.why: The full-layer side field on 6 of 7 rows disagreed with its own already-correct why text and with content's win[] row, which is the exact two-different-answers-to-one-question defect the chart rule exists to catch.
audit.corrected: phases[1..6].side moved to Leona to match win[1..6] and their own why text, which needed no rewrite since it already described Leona winning.

audit.why: Level 2 E-Q stun landing before Q Tongue Lash stacks 3 times, and level 6 Solar Flare beating a reactive R Devour save, are both real sourced spikes.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text, wants.you[1], wants.foe[1] and wants.foe[2] all swap Tahm Kench's W and R: they call Devour "W" and Abyssal Dive "R". enemyAbilities confirms W=Abyssal Dive, R=Devour. This is the same class of fabricated-name error the brief calls out (Brand's R, Cassiopeia's Q). Separately, Thick Skin (E) — his damage-storing shield — is never mentioned anywhere in the matchup despite missingInteractions flagging both needs-antiheal and shield-absorbs-burst for it, and breakdown.cooldowns carries no cooldown number (lint).
audit.why: enemyKit slot list is definitive: Q=Tongue Lash, W=Abyssal Dive, E=Thick Skin, R=Devour. Thick Skin banks a shield from stored damage taken while out of combat — burst racing it before it converts matters as much as dodging Devour.
audit.corrected: Swapped W/R labels back to correct across the four content fields; added Thick Skin's shield-bank and Q's real cooldown into breakdown.cooldowns.

edits.before: - Tahm Kench Abyssal Dive: matchup-defining — His re-engage and his escape — all-in only while it is down. It writes your spacing rules. - W Eclipse is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: Tongue Lash (Q) is down 7s at rank 1, 5s at max — three landed stacks stun, so track his count. Thick Skin (E) banks a shield off damage taken — burst him before it fills. Abyssal Dive (W) is his re-engage; Devour (R) saves one ally on a long cooldown — force it early.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Tongue Lash only threatens inside 900 range — bait a whiff from just outside it, then start the chain while it's down.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with armor.
edits.after: Don't commit into a banked Devour — force it out on a support first, then chain the carry it can't save twice.

edits.before: Solar Flare stun beats Tahm's defensive R Abyssal Dive commit; when you E onto his ADC he can only Devour (W) to save them, and if he does you focus him instead while he's out of position.
edits.after: Solar Flare stun beats Tahm's defensive W Abyssal Dive commit; when you E onto his ADC he can only Devour (R) to save them, and if he does you focus him instead while he's out of position.

edits.before: Bait out his W Devour then re-engage on its cooldown
edits.after: Bait out his R Devour then re-engage on its cooldown

edits.before: Save an ADC with W Devour to negate your all-in burst
edits.after: Save an ADC with R Devour to negate your all-in burst

edits.before: Use R Abyssal Dive to roam and flank rather than trade in lane
edits.after: Use W Abyssal Dive to roam and flank rather than trade in lane

notes: Real ability-name error found and fixed: four content fields swapped Tahm Kench's W (Abyssal Dive) and R (Devour). Chart fix: phases[1] through [6].side all carried the stale "Skill" placeholder while content win[1..6] and their own matching why text already said Leona — moved all six to Leona per the chart rule (win already correct, side alone needed to catch up; no why rewrite needed since it already agreed). Fixed lint: copy-paste bleed on dosFull[1].d/dontsFull[2].d and digit-free breakdown.cooldowns, which now also covers Thick Skin's shield-bank (missingInteractions: shield-absorbs-burst) and real Tongue Lash cooldowns; needs-antiheal is already covered generically by report[8].t.
